tei:div.tei:p: (nga )༄༅// thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i sngon 'gro'i rjes gnang thugs rje'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba bzhugs so// rgyal kun thugs rje gcig gyur sems dpa'i tshul// thugs rje che dang phyag rgya chen po dag /zung 'jug nyams su len tshul rjes gnang bcas// sa skya'i 'jam mgon las byung deng 'dir spel// 'dir 'phags pa thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa gtso rkyang dpal ldan sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i rjes gnang ji ltar bya ba'i tshul la/ gnas dben par maṇ+ḍal la dri bzang gi thig le byas la tshom bu gcig bkod/ mtha' skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang gtor ma gcig bsham/ slob dpon gyi mdun du rdo rje dril bu me tog rnams nyer bsdogs bya/ slob dpon gyis mchod pa rnams a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i sogs nas rol mo dharma ra ṇi bcas pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ skyabs 'gro dang sems bskyed spyi ltar byas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rang gi lus mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sangs kyis dag par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las rang nyid skad cig gis rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar nas sangs rgyas thams cad la sems can gyi don mdzad par bskul ba/ g.yas 'og mas phreng ba dkar po dang*/ g.yon 'og mas rin po che dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ snyan rgyan/ mgul rgyan la sogs pa rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' gsol ba/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa/

spyi bo na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan pa snang la rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i skur gyur par bsgoms la yid cung zad gzung*/ de nas spyi bo'i 'od dpag med la dmigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'od dpag tu med pas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyang zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas gsol ba lan gsum gdab/ de nas 'di ltar bsams te/ bde ba dang sdug bsngal ba dang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad kyi rtsa ba rang gi sems yin la/ sems de'ang brtag na kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub/ gcig dang du ma yang ma yin pas rang gi ngo bos stong*/ ngo bo med pa'i dbang gis gdod ma nas skye ba med pas dang po rgyus stong*/ skye ba med pa'i phyir sdod pa med pas bar du gnas pas stong*/ gnas rgyu med pa'i phyir 'jig pa med pas tha ma 'gags pas stong ste/ gzhi dang rtsa ba med cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'o zhes spros pa bcad la mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa gang yang mi bsgom zhing yid la mi byed par spros bral gyi ngang la yid lhod de mnyam par gzhag des skyo bar gyur pa na sngags bzla ste/ rang gi snying gar zla ba'i steng du hrīḥyig gi mthar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba las 'od zer sngags kyi tshul du 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul nas rigs drug sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ thugs rje chen po'i go 'phang la bkod/ 'od zer tshur 'dus te bdag gi snying gar thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/

oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ 'phags pa thugs rje chen pos bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad sbyang zhing byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems dam pa rgyud la skyes nas myur du 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi go 'phang thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes gsol ba gdab/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas kyi sar bsngo'o// thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i tshul lo// mdun gyi maṇ+ḍal tshom bu bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥdakar po las thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs sogs nas/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ thugs ka'i dbus su hrīḥ thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas ye shes sems dpa' spyan drangs/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas dam tshig par bstim/ slar yang hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ dbang gi lha rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs nas sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ār+ya a wa lo ki te shwa ra sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa'i mtshan sngags re re sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod dharmā ra ṇi dang bcas pas mchod/ skyon gyis ma gos sogs kyis bstod/

gtor ma bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la 'bru gsum lan gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya dang mtshan sngags la a kā ro btags pa lan gsum la sogs pas phul/ mchod bstod bsdus pa byas la/ 'dod don dngos grub zhus/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ slob ma rnams khrus byas gral la 'khod pa la me tog bkye bsdu byas la/ slob dpon gyis sems bskyed gsol 'debs rgyas bsdus gang rung byas/ 'dir khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po dpal sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa gtso rkyang gi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la/ slob dpon gyi bgyi ba thams cad grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa slob ma'i bya ba la maṇ+ḍal 'bul ba/ gsol ba gdab pa/ rgyud dag par bya ba/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba gdab pa rnams sngon du 'gro dgos pas/ slob dpon 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang tha mi dad snyam pas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ phyag me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang sogs dang*/ rgyud dag par bya ba'i slad du mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor nas bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs lan gsum byas nas/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dam pas bdag la thugs rje chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs kyi sku gsung thugs kyi rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba gdab pa rnams rjes gnang gi sngon 'gro yin/ dngos gzhi la thog mar rjes gnang gi gzhi dgod pa'i slad du slob dpon gyis/ oṃ swa bhā wa sogs brjod pas khyed rnams kyi tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang rnam smin gdos bcas kyi phung po khams dang skye mched la sogs pa stong pa nyid du sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ khyed rnams kyi sems nyid kyi ngo bo hrīḥlas thugs rje chen po sogs nas sems can gyi don mdzad pa'i sku can rer gyur pa'i mos pa mdzod/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas de rnams kyi thugs rgyud bskul/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo la/ rnam pa 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i sku tshad med/ grangs med pa spyan drangs nas khyed rnams kyi lus la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par mos zhes dang*/ 'bru drug dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ oṃ badz+ra a be sha ya aḥ.aḥ.aḥzhes yang yang brjod/ des thugs rje chen po'i sku'i byin rlabs zhugs/ lus kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ lus thugs rje chen po'i sku dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ rjes gnang dngos la lung gsum las/ rjes su bzlas pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las/ sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ slob dpon gyi zhal nas 'thon/ khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig gi mthar 'khod par mos nas/ 'di'i rjes zlos brgya rtsa gcig mdzod/ oṃ ma ṇi sogs rjes zlos byar gzhug de ltar lan gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/

gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pa man chad kyis brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor zhing 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gis gzung lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyis kyang*/ me tog phreng ba sngags su byas pa spyi bor bzhag cing byin gyis brlabs par mos/ bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la 'go bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// rdo rje slob ma'i rgyud la 'phags pa thugs rje chen po'i gsang sngags kyi byin rlabs thams cad 'jug par gyur cig ces brjod cing me tog gtor/ dam bca' ba'i lung gi slad du/ dus 'di nas bzung ste byang chub ma thob kyi bar du thugs rje chen po yi dam du 'dzin snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ slob dpon dgongs su gsol/ bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi bas/ dus 'di nas bzung ste/ ji srid byang chub snying po la mchis kyi bar du 'phags pa thugs rje chen po yi dam gyi lhar gzung bar bgyi'o// zhes lan gsum/ des thugs rje chen po'i gsung gi byin rlabs zhugs/ ngag gi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/ ngag thugs rje chen po'i gsung dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ byin gyis brlabs pa'i lung gi slad du/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ mdun bskyed kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi ngo bo thugs rje chen po'i sku mtheb sor gyi tshad tsam re thugs ka nas bye ste byon pa khyed rnams kyi spyi bo nas thim pas/ thugs ka'i hrīḥyig dang dbyer med du gyur par mos/ de'i ngang las lha sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la yid cher gyis gtad pas lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od zer gyi rnam par gyur te thugs ka'i hrīḥl thim/

de yang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkhar 'ja' yal ba ltar yal te/ bde ba dang*/ sdug bsngal ba dang*/ 'khor ba dang*/ mya ngan las 'das pa sogs gong ltar brjod nas gzhi dang rtsa ba med cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bur shes par byas nas/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa gang yang mi bsgom zhing yid la mi byed pa spros bral gyi ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog mdzod/ des thugs rje chen po'i thugs kyi byin rlabs zhugs/ sems kyi sgo nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhig dag sems thugs rje chen po'i thugs dang nus pa mnyam par byin gyis brlabs snyam du mos pa mdzod/ des rjes gnang gi dngos gzhi grub nas/ gtso bos sogs dang*/ maṇ+ḍal/ deng nas brtsams te sogs spyi ltar byas nas slob ma rnams rang gnas su gtang bar bya'o// tshom bu'i lha la mchod bstod byas nas dngos grub gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing nongs pa bzod par gsol nas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus te bsngo ba smon lam bkra shis rnams kyis mtha' brgyan par bya'o// dus gsum rgyal ba kun dngos thugs rje'i gter// 'phags mchog gru 'dzin dbang po sgrub pa'i thabs// bgyis pa'i dge bas 'gro tshogs srid pa las// gdon pa'i g.yar dam mtha' ru phyin par shog /ces dpal sa skya pa nas brgyud pa'i 'phags pa thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i sngon 'gro'i rjes gnang thugs rje'i chu rgyun zhes bya ba 'di ni bla ma gong ma rnams 'phags pa rin po ches mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs la brten nas rjes gnang snyan brgyud kyi tshul du 'bogs pa las sngon chad yi ger bkod pa med mod/ phyi nas de ltar yod pa mi shes pa'i rgyus rgyun nub par 'gyur du dogs nas ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bgyi bas lhun grub steng gi chos grwar bgyis pa dge'o//

// ༄༅// tsha gsur gyi cho ga bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma lhag pa'i lhar btud de// tsha gsur btang 'dod 'di skad do// dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su mchi// gzhan don byang chub spyod pa spyad// sngon 'gro'o// bdag nyid spyan ras gzigs dbang gsal// snying ga'i hrīḥlas 'od zer 'phros// mchod yul rgya mtsho gzhi bdag dang*// 'gro ba rigs drug lan chags bgegs// dri za bar dor gnas pa bcas// thams cad tshur spyon 'dir bzhugs shig /spyan 'dren ni/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ chos kun stong pa'i ngang nyid las// gsur mchod 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga// ci 'dod rtag par 'jo ba'i sprin// zhing kun khyab par rgyas gyur cig /byin brlab bo// sam+bha ra lan bdun gyis bsngos la/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi'i mtshan brjod/ gnam sa'i dkyil 'khor yongs khengs pa// 'dod yon gsur gyi mchod sprin 'di// bla ma yi dam lha yi tshogs// rgyal ba sras slob thams cad dang*// bstan srung nor sbyin bcas la 'bul// yul lha gzhi bdag gnas bdag dang*// rab dga' zur phud lnga pa sogs// zas su dri la bza' rnams dang*// mar gyur rigs drug sems can dang*// lan chags sha 'khon bgegs kyi rigs// shi nas ring por ma lon pa'i// srid pa bar do'i sems can bcas// kun la sbyin no thob par gyur// mchod sbyin no// mchod yul rgya mtsho mnyes gyur nas// bdag gzhan phyi nang bar chad zhi// tshe blo bsod nams longs spyod rgyas// skye 'gro chags shing 'dun pa dang*// dgra bgegs gdug pa tshar gcod mdzod// sbyin gnas 'jig rten skyong tshogs kyis// nyes srungs legs pa'i phyogs la sbyor// bar do'i 'gro rnams 'jigs skrag dang*// 'khrul snang sdug bsngal kun las thar// 'gro drug srid pa'i sdug bsngal las// rnam grol sangs rgyas thob par shog /las bcol lo// srid zhi'i mgron rnams rang gnas su// gshegs pa'i tshul ston badz+ra muḥ

/gshegs gsol lo// bdag gzhan dge ba'i rtsa ba 'dis// 'chi khar nad gcod sdug bsngal bral// sangs rgyas zhing kun bgrod pa dang*// sems can yongs su smin byed shog /bsngo ba'o// zhes tsha gsur cho ga dpag bsam yal 'dab ces pa 'di'ang nye bar gnas pa'i ngor ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis so// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
